mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate hiring and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% in 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales growth signals weakening consumer demand, triggering negative feedback in corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve tightens policy, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 115.0 in a 3-month window, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 115.0 in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts signals strong consumer confidence and rising home construction, boosting economic activity and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate and decline in non-farm payrolls signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During strong economic expansion (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0%), corporate earnings growth supports higher equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
